name: obsidian-wp-sync
description: Obsidian ↔ WordPress multi-site content sync (core + CLI + Obsidian plugin + crawl4ai)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @obsidian-wp-sync/core && npm run build -w @obsidian-wp-sync/cli && npm run build -w @obsidian-wp-sync/obsidian-plugin
scripts.plugin:install: npm run build -w @obsidian-wp-sync/obsidian-plugin && npm run install-to-vault -w @obsidian-wp-sync/obsidian-plugin --
